children: Cybersecurity and cloud services provider's Q3 revenue rose more than 75% yr/yr, driven by procurement demand
Q3 net loss narrowed to $0.8 mln from $1.1 mln a year earlier
Q3 adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $0.2 mln vs negative $0.3 mln last year
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods in its press release

PROCUREMENT REVENUE SURGE - Co said Q3 revenue growth was primarily driven by a 271% increase in procurement revenue as customers accelerated infrastructure investments in cybersecurity, cloud modernization, data center expansion and AI
LARGE CUSTOMER ORDER - Co said it fulfilled a significant customer order during Q3, contributing to revenue growth
RECURRING REVENUE GROWTH - Core managed services revenue from non-affiliated customers increased 33% yr/yr, reflecting efforts to deepen customer relationships and diversify revenue
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
